# Fixture: spotread 柔光罩未移除错误
# 来源: 手写，基于 ArgyllCMS spotread 柔光罩错误实际输出
# 工具版本: ArgyllCMS v2.2.x / v3.x
# 命令: spotread -e -d l -c 1

# ========== 启动阶段 ==========
ArgyllCMS spotread - Emissive (Display) measurement utility
Version 2.2.1

Setting up instrument ...
Found instrument 'hid:111 (i1 Display Pro, ColorMunki Display)'
Serial Number: XXXXXXXX
Place instrument on measurement area ...
Hit any key to continue:

# ========== 柔光罩错误 ==========
# i1 Display Pro 等色度计有柔光罩（ambient filter）
# 用于环境光测量，但显示测量时需要移除
# 如果未移除，spotread 会报错

The instrument sensor is being in the wrong position,
or the ambient filter should be removed.

# ========== 预期解析结果 ==========
# 错误关键词检测:
# - "ambient filter should be removed" -> 柔光罩错误
# - "sensor being in the wrong position" -> 传感器位置错误
# - 应触发 SPOTREAD_ERROR_KEYWORDS 匹配
# - 应触发 ERROR_MESSAGE_MAP 映射

# ========== 用户提示建议 ==========
# ERROR_MESSAGE_MAP['ambient filter should be removed'] =
#   '柔光罩未移除，请确保柔光罩已打开或移除后再进行测量'

# ========== 关键检测点 ==========
# - 这是硬件状态错误，需要用户干预
# - 不是 USB 断开，不需要自动断开连接
# - 但需要暂停测量，等待用户处理
